claims.statement: At the C1 landing commit the census of record is a reading of a named revision. Its `measured-at:` line names the C2 landing revision; its `pinned rate (INTERNAL only; revision-stable)` line equals `corpus/instruments/census-at-rev.py`'s re-measurement of that revision (INTERNAL-only numerator: lane-relative citations that exist in the extract); its `host-inclusive rate (resolve.py's definition)` line records RESOLVES + MIRROR-EQUIVALENT + INTERNAL; and its `host-owned inputs` line counts the absolute-path citations that resolve outside the lane, reported separately (R142). The body below the header is resolve.py's own generated output for that revision, with the scratch extract path replaced by the lane root and the revision. The instrument extracts `git archive REV` into --work (never the live lane), runs the extract's own resolve.py, reads the generated TSV (class from cells[-7], scopes from the last cell, so a citation containing tabs cannot shift the columns), and caches one measurement per revision. Before: the census named no revision, was generated from a 224-file tree, and its SKILL rate 132/701 does not reproduce at the base (the base reads 162/732 pinned, 166/732 host-inclusive).
claims.predicate: P1: `python3 -B corpus/instruments/census-at-rev.py --lane . --check corpus/instruments/citation-survival.md --work <scratch>` at the C1 landing prints `CENSUS-CHECK pass rev=<C2 landing> skill=<n>/<m> corpus=<a>/<b> lane=<c>/<d> host_owned=<h>` with rc 0, and the printed pinned triple equals the file's `pinned rate` line. P2: `.ufo/waves/round-98/controls/c1-controls-r98.py --lane . --work <scratch> --instrument corpus/instruments/census-at-rev.py --base 2133f5bd993aaf34efad795d5e0b588485401fb2` prints `C1-CONTROLS-RESULT pass controls=8 rc=0` and `ATTRIBUTION pass fixtures=8` at the landing (post-landing re-run). P3: the file's `measured-at:` revision is an ancestor of the branch tip at the C1 landing, and the file body contains no scratch path (`grep -c '/fast/scratch' corpus/instruments/citation-survival.md` prints 0).
claims.kill: Any of P1-P3 FAIL at the landing, a control or attribution fixture that does not reproduce when re-run after the landing, or a `measured-at` that is not an ancestor of the branch tip: C1 NOT VERIFIED. No target narrowing, no hand-edited pinned line, no re-pointing `measured-at` after data.

claims.statement: At the C2 landing commit corpus/instruments/capture-secret-scan.py reports four new shapes — `gitlab-ci-build-token` (`glcbt-` + 1-5 `A-Za-z0-9` + `_` + exactly 20 `A-Za-z0-9_-`, right boundary `(?![A-Za-z0-9])`), `gitlab-iam-refresh-token` (`gliamrt-` + exactly 43 + `.` + exactly 43, right boundary `(?![A-Za-z0-9_-])`), `gitlab-iam-authorization-code` (`gliamac-` + 43 + `.` + 43, same boundary) and `gitlab-session-cookie` (the `_gitlab_session` assignment context, optional `_geo_` + 64 hex, separator, optional `cell-<N>-`, exactly 64 lower-case hex) — and the five round-97 shapes `gitlab-runner-registration-token`, `gitlab-feed-token`, `gitlab-oauth-app-secret`, `gitlab-feed-token-v2` and `gitlab-scim-oauth-token` now use S140's own punct/space/EOL boundary `(?![A-Za-z0-9])`. The selftest reports 170 cases (148 before). The capability gate's plants are generated from each rule's own alphabet and length by the gate itself, never copied from the instrument's selftest literals. A new knowledge entry `corpus/knowledge/gitlab-iam-ci-build-and-session-token-shapes.md` cites S140 and S144.
